title: Quantitative Aptitude
description: Percentages, interest, time and work, speed and ratio questions from placement tests.

cards.question: What is 20% of 150?
15% of a number is 45. What is the number?
A price rises by 10% and then by 20%. What is the total increase?
The price of sugar rises by 25%. By how much must a family cut its use to keep spending the same?
An item bought for ₹400 is sold for ₹500. What is the profit percent?
An item marked ₹1000 gets two successive discounts of 10%. What is the selling price?
What is the simple interest on ₹5000 at 8% per year for 3 years?
What is the compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per year for 2 years, compounded yearly?
A sum doubles in 10 years at simple interest. What is the rate?
A can do a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. How long will they take together?
Pipe A fills a tank in 12 hours; pipe B empties it in 18 hours. With both open, how long to fill it?
Convert 72 km/h to m/s.
A 200 m long train runs at 72 km/h. How long does it take to cross a pole?
A car goes from A to B at 40 km/h and returns at 60 km/h. What is the average speed?
A boat goes 10 km/h in still water and the stream flows at 2 km/h. What are its downstream and upstream speeds?
What is the average of the first 10 natural numbers?
What is the sum of the first n natural numbers?
What are the HCF and LCM of 12 and 18?
For two numbers, how are their product, HCF and LCM related?
cards.answer: Product of the two numbers = HCF × LCM.

cards.question: What is the divisibility rule for 9?
cards.answer: A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

cards.question: Divide 64 in the ratio 3 : 5.
If A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5, what is A : B : C?
What is the angle between the clock hands at 3:15?
Two dice are thrown. What is the probability that the sum is 7?
In how many ways can the letters of LEVEL be arranged?
